Name: Eyelashes
Description: This will create an eyelash system over the eye block

attrs.Help_string:
Overview:
  This will create an eyelash system over the eye block.

How To Use:
  fill the key fields below before build.

Fields:
- SetAttrsPosition: set the target node name.
- If left as default, the tool uses placeholder behavior for setup.
- EyeName: set the node/object name this block should use.
- Template attrs-position examples: Vis_Ctrl, L_Brow_Ctrl, L_Eyelids_Scale_Ctrl.

Tips:
- start with defaults, build once, then tweak only the fields you need.
